speech:
Grizzly Rips, that was an F, and y'all earned every crooked line of it. Nine games, three wins, six losses. Thirty-five goals conceded. That's three point eight nine a match, which isn't a defense, it's a revolving door with a welcome mat. Three losses by four or more. Zero and five to SydSwny FanClub. One and five to pilot grape. And three and nine to Inter Hornz, a scoreline I've only ever seen on a bowling alley screen. We started the day in Division 2 with three chances to find sixteen points. We found zero, got dropped to Division 3, burned through our chances there too, and now we're staring at a relegation match where a draw keeps us in Division 3. And four rage quits. Four. Our average rating was 7.43 against their 7.95, well under our own usual of 7.73.

buddskees. You rage quit while we were up four and two on viscabarca28. Winning! Against Cuc United your passing fell to 53 percent from your usual 81. Against SydSwny you posted a 6.2 when your usual there is 8.1. And your tackle success was 50 percent against a usual 75. Credit where due: five goals, a 9.3 against Dagestan and a 9.1 against BaIIhog.

PhogsToffees. You quit the Inter Hornz game at three and nine. In the zero and five, their best forward put up a perfect 10.0 to your 6.6. Against Cuc United you went zero percent in the tackle. But seven goals and a 9.6 in the BaIIhog win were the brightest light we had all night.

BellyTb1. Two rage quits, including the last game. Zero tackles won out of seven attempts, all day long. Against Dagestan you completed 13 passes out of 24, which is 54 percent. You averaged 6.91 against your usual 7.51. Still, six assists and twelve key passes say the vision is in there.

tuxedo_slide. Against Cuc United you made 7 passes out of 13. Against viscabarca28 you went zero percent in the tackle, and you won 4 tackles out of 18 on the day. Against Inter Hornz you converted zero of your shots. But two assists in that viscabarca win were your most in 18 matches, you touched the ball 35 times in the worst game we played, and you never once walked away. That counts.

Now. When I was a kid, my granddad's pickup died in a ditch every single winter. And every single winter he'd climb out, grab the shovel and say, "Well, the truck's honest. It's telling us where the road ain't." Today told us exactly where the road ain't. It's defensive work rate. So tomorrow we get stuck in. We track our runner all the way into the box. When we lose the ball, the nearest player presses for three to five seconds and everyone else shuts the lanes. And nobody leaves the field, because a team that stays together can dig out of any ditch.

Here's the thing, friends. We still scored twenty-one goals today. That's not a broken team. That's a team with a full tank and a bad map. One draw keeps us up. I believe in every one of you. Get some sleep, and tomorrow we drive.
